CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set) and an explicit origin/presentation record coexist for the same referent/time, and status metadata separates identity from presentation.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to a specific content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (coordinate sets) with color attributes for named referents and current/candidate times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/status metadata (kind, record_time, represented_time), distinguishing identity from presentation/status.

O.rationale: Origin/represented_time metadata explicitly describe the presentation/access state for the identified content.
